name: Cisco ASA — High Volume of Denied Inbound Connections from One IP
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "106023" and xdm.observer.action = "Deny"
| bin _time span = 10m
| comp count() as denies,
       values(xdm.target.ipv4) as dst_ips,
       values(xdm.target.port) as dst_ports,
       values(xdm.network.ip_protocol) as protocols
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter denies >= 138
| fields dst_ips, xdm.source.ipv4, dst_ports, protocols
description: External IP generating an abnormal count of 106023 denies — scanner or attack pattern.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — High Volume of Denied Inbound Connections from One IP
alert_description:
What fired: External IP generating an abnormal count of 106023 denies — scanner or attack pattern.

Why it matters: an actor is enumerating hosts, services, shares, or accounts to map the environment. Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1046 - Network Service Discovery (TA0007 - Discovery).

Investigate:
  - Identify the scanning source and the number/range of targets it touched.
  - Confirm the source is not an authorized scanner/vuln tool; look for follow-on access to any enumerated target.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
